extension.description: Install Backlot from here and Kodi brings in the helper automatically. Updates arrive on their own.

extension.summary: Service presets, logos and custom services for the Backlot skin.
extension.description: Builds the service tiles for the Backlot skin from the studios and networks in your library. Turn presets on or off, reorder them, add your own services, set custom art, and export or import your setup.
extension.news: v0.6.0 - Networks: NBC, CBS, ABC, FOX, Telemundo, A&E, History, Lifetime, MGM+ and the UK channels can have their own tiles, stay inside their streaming service, or both. New Starz, PBS, Univision and Crunchyroll presets. British is now UK TV. Network tiles only appear when you have titles from them. v0.5.1 - New Collections tile logo. v0.5.0 - Each movie collection stays under one service (the one with most of its movies), optional Collections tile after Movies, Max renamed HBO Max. v0.4.9 - Collection artwork pass is much lighter on big libraries: it skips collections it already checked, waits for library scans to finish and starts 30 seconds after Kodi. v0.4.8 - Up Next install from Backlot settings and setup (step 10 of 13). v0.4.6 - Fuller studio lists per service, Discovery+ inside Max, one-step services from the studios report.

extension.summary: An Android TV style skin that organizes your library by service.
extension.description: Backlot groups your local movies and TV shows under the network or studio that made them (Peacock, HBO Max, Netflix, Paramount+, Disney+, NBC, CBS, ABC, FOX, BBC and more), with an Android TV / Google TV style home screen.
extension.news: v0.6.0 - Network tiles (NBC, CBS, ABC, FOX, BBC and more) and UK TV, set up in a new onboarding step or Manage services > Networks. v0.5.4 - New Collections tile logo. v0.5.3 - Collections tile and Collections header, collections kept together under one service, and Back never lands on the Videos menu (it goes home). v0.5.2 - Max is called HBO Max again (existing setups are renamed unless you renamed it yourself). v0.5.1 - Paused info screen now appears when you pause from the on-screen controls (they close after 5 idle seconds). v0.5.0 - New player: paused info screen, chapter marks and names on the progress bar, current subtitle and audio on the OSD, Backlot-styled Up Next card (install it from Backlot settings or setup), and the progress bar no longer shows a solid white track. v0.4.9 - File manager is back in Settings (add sources, copy, move, rename, delete). v0.4.8 - Info screens and episode lists no longer start a line with a stray dot when a director or runtime is missing. v0.4.7 - Check for Backlot updates button in settings. v0.4.6 - Services now include the studios their companies own (Paramount Pictures in Paramount+, MGM in Prime Video and more). Discovery+ inside Max option. Clearer studios report with one-step new services.

extension.summary: Soft navigation sounds for the Backlot skin.
extension.description: Gentle ticks as you move and a pop when you select, in the spirit of Android TV.
A repository for alpha releases of jurialmunkey's skins.
